_about: The forecast's inputs. Both the Model page (model/model.js) and code/forecast_curve.py read this file; edit here only. Probabilities are 0-1. low_case/high_case mean a lower/higher chance of Yes, so for t0 the low case is the later year.

L.note: life exists and can be found, eventually

T0.note: steepest point of the S-curve, years from as_of

K.note: steepness; 0.44 = the 10%-to-90% rise takes about 10 years

C.note: a discovery becomes a definitive U.S. statement

P_DISCLOSE.note: this administration discloses it, given it exists

P_REMARK.note: an off-the-cuff remark that counts, by the end of the term (cut from 2% on 2026-11-05)
